name: chrysaki-lag
description: Shows why the machine lags and warns about disk, memory, heat and system faults

busyAt.title: Busy at
busyAt.description: The pressure share, in percent over 10 s, at which any resource makes the machine busy

ioLaggyAt.title: Disk laggy at
ioLaggyAt.description: The IO pressure share, in percent over 10 s, at which the machine is laggy

memoryLaggyAt.title: Memory laggy at
memoryLaggyAt.description: The memory pressure share, in percent over 10 s, at which the machine is laggy

cpuLaggyAt.title: CPU laggy at
cpuLaggyAt.description: The CPU pressure share, in percent over 10 s, at which the machine is laggy

desktopNotify.title: Desktop notice
desktopNotify.description: Send a notice through notify-send when the lag lasts a minute, at most once every 15 minutes

diskWarnAt.title: Disk warn at
diskWarnAt.description: The share of a disk in use, in percent, at which a warning shows

diskCritAt.title: Disk critical at
diskCritAt.description: The share of a disk in use, in percent, at which the warning turns critical

cpuTempWarnAt.title: CPU warm at
cpuTempWarnAt.description: The CPU temperature, in degrees Celsius, at which a warning shows after two readings in a row

cpuTempCritAt.title: CPU hot at
cpuTempCritAt.description: The CPU temperature, in degrees Celsius, at which the warning turns critical

warnNotify.title: Warning notice
warnNotify.description: Send a notice through notify-send for a critical warning, at most once per warning per hour
